name: Rhizophora mangrove forest field hydrodynamics dataset from Yoshikai et al. (2022)
model_or_instrument: Acoustic Doppler velocimeters and pressure sensors in Aklan, Philippines
resolution: Vertical velocity profiles across 4 tidal ebb conditions (water depths 0.21–0.53 m)

scales.note: Intertidal mangrove field site in Aklan, Philippines from Yoshikai et al. (2022); measurement duration and exact sensor spacing across the four profiles are not reported.
